expectations.text: The pending session cleanup work is referenced as a future-forward link using double-bracket notation (e.g., [[Procedure - ...]] or similar)

suggestions: Add an Observations section to artifact files with [fact], [decision], [problem], [solution] inline category tags on each statement — this is a core ontology-extractor format requirement that was completely absent.
Add a Revision Management section (e.g., with a [r1] entry recording the initial creation date, author, and summary) to at least the primary artifact to satisfy the revision tracking requirement.
Use double-bracket wiki-link notation ([[Procedure - Automated Token Cleanup]]) for forward references to open/pending work items, rather than plain prose or table references.
eval_feedback.overall: The executor produced a well-structured and content-rich knowledge artifact covering facts, concepts, procedures, narrative, open items, and relations. It passed 2 of 5 format-compliance expectations: the Narrative section header and the typed Relations section. It failed 3 expectations that require specific ontology-extractor format conventions: categorized Observations with [category] tags, a Revision Management section with [r1] entry, and double-bracket forward-link notation for the pending session cleanup work. These are structural conventions of the target skill that the executor did not apply, likely because it was running without the skill prompt.
